# 3105 source pin

The Apps Manager and Patches integration is imported from
[`NightVibes33/3105`](https://github.com/NightVibes33/3105) commit
`1da66f733a7ad6bb5c9e1d078e89cfbb02faec72`.

The selected SwiftUI app-data browser, file operations, portable `.3105`
package codec, Keychain storage, patch transaction, backup, restore, and native
app metadata helper sources are compiled into FilzaSlop. Filza-specific host,
navigation, diagnostics, and ContainerManager bridge adaptations live in the
top-level integration files. The upstream GPLv3 license and third-party notices
are preserved in this directory.
